shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.next/**'"' | sort && for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/*.js; do echo \"===== "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,300p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null || true && find public -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"not-found.*metadata|metadata.*not-found|export const metadata\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -g '*.md' | rg 'not-found|404' | head -80 && rg -n \"valid.*export|invalid.*export|not-found\" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/plugins/next-types-plugin node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "find app components -type f -maxdepth 5 -print | sort && git diff -- app components styles/globals.css | sed -n '1,500p'"
/bin/bash -lc "find app -maxdepth 6 -type f -print | sort && sed -n '1,320p' 'app/blog/[id]/page.tsx' && sed -n '1,260p' app/blog/page.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "find pages -print 2>/dev/null || true && rmdir 'pages/api/posts' 'pages/api' 'pages/blog' pages 2>/dev/null || true && if [ -d pages ]; then find pages -print; else echo 'pages directory removed'; fi && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi(Request|Response)|pages/\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' . || true && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.next/**'"' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json next.config.ts package.json && git diff -- pages components styles/globals.css | sed -n '1,700p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
for route in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/42 /does-not-exist /api/posts /api/posts/7; do
  status=$(curl -sS -o "/tmp/app-router-${route//'"\\//_}.body\" -w '%{http_code}' -A 'MigrationSmokeTest/1.0' \"http://127.0.0.1:3210"'$route")
  echo "$status $route"
done
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- API POST valid'
curl -sS -i -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Typed post\",\"content\":\"Route Handler\"}' http://127.0.0.1:3210/api/posts | sed -n '1,12p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- API POST validation'
curl -sS -i -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Missing content\"}' http://127.0.0.1:3210/api/posts | sed -n '1,12p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- API PUT'
curl -sS -i -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Updated\"}' http://127.0.0.1:3210/api/posts/7 | sed -n '1,12p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- API DELETE'
curl -sS -i -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:3210/api/posts/7 | sed -n '1,12p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- unsupported method'
curl -sS -i -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:3210/api/posts | sed -n '1,12p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- metadata/content assertions'
rg -o '<title>["'^<]*|MigrationSmokeTest/1'"\\.0|Welcome to My Blog' /tmp/app-router-_.body | head -10
rg -o '<title>["'^<]*|All Blog Posts'"' /tmp/app-router-_blog.body | head -10
rg -o '<title>["'^<]*|Comments '"\\([0-9]+\\)' /tmp/app-router-_blog_1.body | head -10
rg -o '<title>["'^<]*|404 - Page Not Found'"' /tmp/app-router-_does-not-exist.body | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/app-router-_does-not-exist.body','utf8'); for (const m of s.matchAll(/<title["'^>]*>.*?<'"\\\\/title>/g)) console.log(m[0]); for (const m of s.matchAll(/<meta["'^>]*(description|robots)[''^>]*>/g)) console.log(m[0])"'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && find .next/types -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort | sed -n '1,80p' && sed -n '1,280p' .next/types/routes.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/app-router-not-found-final.body -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3210/does-not-exist && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/app-router-not-found-final.body','utf8'); console.log([...s.matchAll(/<title["'^>]*>.*?<'"\\\\/title>/g)].map(m=>m[0]).join('\\\\n')); console.log([...s.matchAll(/<meta["'^>]*(?:name='"\\\\\\\"(?:description|robots)\\\\\\\"|name=\\\\\\\"robots\\\\\\\")["'^>]*>/g)].map(m=>m[0]).join('"'\\\\n'))\" && curl -sS -o /tmp/app-router-missing-post.body -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3210/blog/999 && rg -o '<title>["'^<]*|404 - Page Not Found|noindex'"' /tmp/app-router-missing-post.body | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/app-router-missing-post.body','utf8'); for(const m of s.matchAll(/.{0,120}(?:title|404 - Page Not Found).{0,180}/g)) console.log(m[0])\" | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "for file in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/not-found.tsx app/error.tsx app/global-error.tsx app/blog/page.tsx 'app/blog/[id]/page.tsx' 'app/blog/[id]/back-button.tsx' 'app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx' app/api/posts/route.ts 'app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts' components/AppProvider.tsx styles/globals.css next-env.d.ts tsconfig.json; do echo \"===== "'$file"; sed -n '"'1,360p' \""'$file"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null || true && git check-ignore -v node_modules .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo package-lock.json 2>/dev/null || true && git ls-files | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && if [ -d pages ]; then echo 'ERROR: pages directory still exists'; exit 1; fi && if rg -n \"from ['\\\"]next/(router|head|document)['\\\"]|\\bget(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)\\b|\\bNextApi(Request|Response)\\b\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' .; then echo 'ERROR: Pages Router APIs remain'; exit 1; else echo 'No Pages Router directory or legacy APIs remain'; fi && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,130p'; nl -ba app/blog/page.tsx | sed -n '1,140p'; nl -ba 'app/blog/[id]/page.tsx' | sed -n '1,220p'; nl -ba app/api/posts/route.ts | sed -n '1,180p'; nl -ba 'app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts' | sed -n '1,220p'; nl -ba app/error.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/not-found.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba components/AppProvider.tsx | sed -n '1,130p'"
